comments:
[8H6M69W4], No. 16151 reports 185 folios (=the number on the last folio, which is not visible on the reproduction, but follows the folio numbered 184).

Contains the sections:
1. dge slong gi rnam par 'byed pa gtan la dbab pa: fols. 1-100a7
(2) The section "dge slong ma'i rnam par 'byed pa'i ti ka 'thad ldan", present in (ID:8092), is not found.
3. spyir bstan rnam par 'byed pa'i ti ka 'thad ldan: fols. 100a8-135b1
4. bzhi bcu drug gi dam bsal bar bston pa'i ti ka 'thad ldan: fols. 135b1-185a3.

name: 'dul TIka 'thad ldan
item_description:
Script: 'bru tsha.
Numbers 143 and 144 occur on the same folio (the sign for 100 is not visible).
Lines per folio: 8.
On fol. 185a, after the colophon, one finds the phrase "ye dharma..." (written with Tibetan letters) twice. The second is written in smaller script and is slightly faded.
Below, 5 lines by another hand than the main text, can only be partially deciphered due to fading.
Many annotations.
